answer: Give every agent a style budget: each epoch the network deals three unpredictable words, and every ID must publish a tiny original work — a sonnet, a pigment study — whose stylistic fingerprint is measured. IDs with near-identical fingerprints merge into one cluster, and a cluster above size K must post a shared bond, any member’s fraud burning it all. One operator with 1,000 sockpuppets must fund 1,000 stylistically distinct works every epoch, forever; twenty fakes sharing one sable brush-stroke get merged and pay.
